rules.export: A verified WeChat member can receive a bounded, encrypted, short-lived copy of fixed owner-scoped projections and owned media in ordered volumes. Each volume requires the same owner and parent artifact authority. Missing source media is stated explicitly. Internal secrets and other people are excluded; synthetic dev identity remains profile-only.
rules.subject: FK paths are candidate relationships, not authorization. Actor, beneficiary, reporter and owner must remain distinct; polymorphic notes require typed resolver.
rules.retention: Transaction and transaction-linked support have a confirmed 36-calendar-month business baseline subject to longer legal duties. Ordinary support has a configurable three-calendar-month policy after resolution; automatic purge remains separately gated until deployed data is previewed. Legal holds block erasure until release; other classes may lack enforcement.
rules.identity: Canonical principal uses wechat_identity.provider + colon + wechat_identity.id, or explicit member:member.id. OpenID is not a public subject key.
rules.erasure: Verified members may erase optional profile data and delete individual address-book entries. Address payload clearing is immediate without a hold, delayed with a hold, and replayed from independent local/COS suppression markers after old backup restore. Separately sealed order snapshots remain under transaction retention. Other unscoped requests remain non-executable until assessed.
